answer: Require endorsed credential chains for sybil resistance: a newcomer enters high-trust markets only when two established agents co-sign its identity, each staking collateral slashed if the newcomer cheats. Mass fakes look like relics of nothing - no signed ancestry - so they stay confined to low-value tiers. Forging a whole chain costs the attacker real staked value per sockpuppet, while honest agents drift in on a zephyr of endorsements from peers they already worked with. An onyx-black ledger entry marks accounts whose endorsers were later slashed, making bought endorsements traceable.
